name: Marché Total de Bacongo
subtitle: Brazzaville's largest traditional marketplace, famous for Congolese fabrics, smoked river fish, and medicinal roots.

facts.label: Origins
facts.value: Established in 1957 near a Total service station on Avenue Matsoua

facts.label: Specialties
facts.value: Congolese pagne wax textiles, smoked capitaine and catfish, cassava leaves (saka-saka), and traditional herbal remedies

parts.text: The largest, most energetic market in Brazzaville, located in the cultural bastion of Bacongo along Avenue Matsoua. Founded in 1957 near a petrol station from which it took its popular name, Marché Total functions as the primary distribution center for fresh food arriving from the Pool department, river produce from the Congo, colorful Congolese wax print textiles (pagnes), tailored apparel, and natural botanicals used in traditional pharmacopoeia, representing the quintessential community marketplace of the capital.
